items.item: [^axiom] (the step) re-said by E3, E5, E6, E8
items.how: Lead now says how far each part has been seen: 'What the step is, proved; that where relations close holding one's own continuation needs no step, proved in steps not yet joined into one theorem; which relation a self continues along, open.' Gone: 'The continuation condition, and how far it has been seen', 'The theory states this step as a condition, not asserting it', 'who holds the condition and its step, and C', and the scope/order sentence of the old frame. In: the condition read on relations, held de se, holds exactly where every center's closure is the whole (ownClosure_unrestricted_iff) and on the root is 续无外 (ownClosure_unrestricted_iff_noOutside, 07 §4.5); where relations close every reach closure is the whole (Flow.mutuallyDependent_iff_reach, 05) and along such a relation the self's presupposition is the condition with no step (ownClosure_unrestricted_of_whole), 'the two are not yet joined into one theorem' (no joint theorem claimed or written); one center only on an acyclic relation, dated occurrences among them («续无外则同一中心»); where relations run one way concern along dependence does not reach those who depend on one (Downstream.one_way, Clearing.center_not_derived, 07 §3.3), 'there the step, like T8's way of seeing, reaches further, as seeing, not as a warrant'; the decomposition (standpoint invariance; unrestricted_iff_presupposed_along, §4.1), the one question (ownClosure_standpointInvariant_iff), P1–P4, Gewirth/Parfit kept; 'The condition alone ranks nothing (07 §4); where it holds, holding one's own continuation orders courses as widening does (the note on the ethics)'; Open: whether actual relations close and which relation a self continues along, P2 and P4, how scope and order form within the dynamics (08 §12, E9). Chinese mirrored.

items.item: [^ethics] (attached to 'This law, with that one step ... a second reading ... is better') re-said by E2, E4, E6, E7, E8
items.how: Lead is the screen's how-far clause in the note's place: 'That where relations close holding one's own continuation orders courses as widening does is proved, on listed courses, in steps not yet joined into one theorem; that a life holds its own continuation is argued, and in the proofs it is a hypothesis derived from no dynamics; the way of seeing is offered for life.' Body: 'The ethics emerges from continuation, not the other way round'; Weighting.IncreasingInOwn a hypothesis derived from no dynamics, selection or persistence; where the condition holds, with admission decided, a self-concerned order ranks every extension between two level paths whose admissions are listed, every claim counted as living, as C (Comparison) asks (Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn), and self-concern and being increasing in admission coincide from every standpoint, on every listing and for every order, exactly where the condition holds (Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_iff_unrestricted, linked 07 #r-self-concern-and-c-under-the-condition); 'So there the body's "second reading" is not a second premise beside the condition: it is what holding one's own continuation, with nothing outside it, does'; limits kept (one way, listed courses whose admissions end, C on all level paths not following; beyond, C a named order); '"Better" is the word C's theorems use for the wider course; widening and narrowing are more and less future ... not good and evil'; widens_iff_every_positive and Pattanaik–Xu kept. The warrant said once, where a reader would ask (E6): '*No warrant to find.* No should stands beyond becoming, so there is no warrant binding every mind to find, and the ethics does not wait on one'; non-entailment proved (ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails; perspectivist without contradiction, bounded_rival); narrower ranking a matter of reach, argued on the one relational unfolding (08). Gone: 'Open, and offered for life', 'C's reading, not a theorem', 'it binds no one', the warrant as open question, the excludes_rivals 'the theory asserts none' sentence, 'C's premise relocated, and the work does not assert it'. T8 sentence: 'argued, its test named, not designed', as 07 T8 says. Chinese mirrored.

'that widening is better is C's reading' replaced by 'Opening and closing, widening and narrowing, are more and less future, patterns within becoming, not good and evil; right and wrong form within it, in people and AI (07 §1), and where a result ranks the wider course above, it says under which order (the note on the ethics)'. '**Open:** ... the theory derives none' became '*Mixed:* ... the laws show it mixed and weigh it for no one, and a judgment between them names its criterion and who holds it; how such judgments form is in the work's open target (08 §12)'. '*Where all must agree:*' became '*Where every such weighting agrees:*' (the body's words). The lead (a dated withdrawal, E10) and the T5 evidence unchanged. Chinese mirrored.

Lead 'A reading' became 'Argued; in the proofs, a hypothesis.' 'A life that goes on holds its own continuation: what does not hold it ceases' with the 8 November source linked (no name); P1 and Weighting.IncreasingInOwn hypotheses, derived from no dynamics, selection or persistence; self-significance (Valuation.premises_of_unrestricted) kept; 'How holding one's own continuation, recognition and motivation form within the dynamics is the work's open target (08 §12)' for 'belongs to the zero-axiom target, which is open'. Chinese mirrored.

Now 'whether the representation fits the world, and so whether actual relations close as the continuation condition, read on relations, says' (E3: the condition is a statement about relations, not a premise someone adopts). Chinese mirrored.
